title: Perceptual Translation System
subtitle: Multimodal Audio Intelligence
description: A computational system that interprets visual input and translates it into structured acoustic inference through multimodal embeddings. It acts as a translator between modalities, bridging the gap between what is seen and what is heard.
longDescription: This system introduces a Perceptual Translation Pipeline that analyzes visual input, extracts structured semantic meaning, converts it into sound-oriented queries, retrieves audio from a local indexed library, and refines results using acoustic characteristics. The architecture is composed of modular layers (Vision Model, Interpretation Layer, Retrieval System, Acoustic Refinement) that transform visual data into sound-relevant embeddings and structured retrieval outputs.
